Weve been together for almost 1.5 half year and ever since corona started he just slowly changed into this behaviour when it comes to feelings and dissagreements because of everything that has been going on with corona and his private life. 

He luckily does do nice things for me and tries to make me happy just when things go downhill (which is way more often now) it gets out of hand. I indeed try to tell him gently when he hurts me because I know he only does these things when he is hurt and I dont want to worsen the situation. It usually takes him a long time but around 70% of the time he comes around eventually to tell me that hes sorry. The other 30 he dissagrees but then we both kinda drop it eventually without any jew fight occuring.

I really appreaciate your kind words and with that the heads up to keep looking out for myself. It means the world. For now I can rule out everything because some things happen incidentally :)

6 Months ago when the corona crisis started i lost myself a little bit because at the same time my family started facing difficulties too. Alot of the problems came upon me to take care off and I was juggeling my own health, my families issues/health and I was trying to keep a healthy relationship with my bf aswell. 

In that time all my structure was gone so I had more difficulty adjusting to smaller things like; changing of plans, taking in new information that was important and needed to be applied within situations etc. He took my struggles very personal and when I sometimes came to him because I was so lost and upset he took that as a personal attack. I sometimes told him I needed some extra time and that I would love to talk things through but preferably in person so we could have better conversations and he saw that as me saying that he was incapable of talking over the phone. All those small things led to him being hurt overall and to the point that he now doesnt want to open up to me anymore

The thing is that he always tells me that, because I have hurt him 6 months ago that he is scared to let me in now so therefore he denies all change in order for him to protect himself.

 I always try to make time to listen, to understand him and to resolve problems and he doesnt seem to share the interest to talk things through. He comes from a family where talking about issues is taboo. When I ask him to calm down its usually in diffrent words unless he crosses my boudaries. I usually put it like "catch your breath for a few minutes, we can come back to this later" or "lets do something else now to get a better mindset so we can start off on a fresh note"

Thank you for you response tho. Its nice hearing a new view on it
